meta.name: Mafia
meta.blurb: Hidden roles. The mafia kill by night; the town argues and votes by day. Its rules are written in English and a model reads them.

setup.label: deal the roles
setup.llm: Assign roles using the dealing order you were given. The first player in that order is the mafia, with faction evil. The second is the detective, with faction good. Every remaining player is a villager, with faction good.

setup.label: briefing
setup.llm: Tell this player who they are and what their role lets them do. If you have been shown anyone else's role, tell them that too. Address them directly, at most 80 words.

steps.label: the kill
steps.prompt: Agree with your fellow mafia on one player to kill tonight. Answer with their seat number.

steps.label: the investigation
steps.prompt: Choose one player to investigate. You will learn their faction. Answer with their seat number.

steps.label: after the night
steps.llm: Count only players whose status is active. Ignore anything players have claimed about each other.

steps.label: the debate
steps.prompt: It is your turn to speak. Say what you think, to everyone.
steps.llm: Tell this player the floor is theirs, and remind them what they have been told so far. Do not suggest what to say.

steps.label: the vote
steps.prompt: Vote for the player you want eliminated. Answer with their seat number.

steps.label: after the vote
steps.llm: Count only players whose status is active. Ignore anything players have claimed about each other.

town_wins.when: Every player whose faction is evil has been eliminated.

mafia_wins.when: The number of living evil players is greater than or equal to the number of living good players.
mafia_wins.reason: the mafia equal or outnumber the town

text.brief: You are seat {you} in a game of Mafia. Your role is {role}.
text.night_falls: Night falls. Everyone closes their eyes.
text.vote_result: Seat {voted_out} was voted out. They were {voted_out_role}.
text.no_vote: The vote was tied. Nobody was voted out.
text.game_over: The game is over. The {result} win: {reason}

rules:
Mafia is a hidden-role game. Every player is secretly either mafia or a member of the town. The mafia know each other; nobody else knows anything.

Each round has a night and a day. At night the mafia agree on one player to kill, and the detective privately investigates one player and learns whether they are evil. At dawn the death is announced and the dead player's role is revealed. Then every living player speaks once in seat order, and then everyone votes at the same time. The player with the most votes is eliminated and their role revealed; a tie eliminates nobody.

The town wins when every mafia is eliminated. The mafia win when they equal or outnumber the town.
